racePlan.sharpnessHelp: Race sharpness shows whether a rider has enough recent racing rhythm. Higher sharpness helps a rider start sharper and perform more reliably.
racePlan.fatigueHelp: Fatigue is still the main limiter. A rider with good race sharpness but very high fatigue will not start the race fully fresh.
racePlan.freshnessBarHelp: The race-start red freshness bar combines fatigue and race sharpness. It is capped between 50 and 100 so no selected rider starts a race unrealistically empty.

bonus.title: Race Plan Bonus Preview
bonus.description: Race staff, race assets, and team policies are converted into these standardized race-engine percentage bonuses. Hover or click a card to see the source breakdown.
bonus.breakdownHelp: Helpful effects are converted into positive standardized contribution percentages.
bonus.capHelp: If these two numbers differ later, the race engine cap or standardization rule has limited the final bonus.
bonus.noBreakdown: No detailed source rows are available for this bonus yet. Team Policy rows appear only when the current policy setup gives a non-zero bonus.
bonus.none: No standardized race bonuses available yet. Refresh the quote after selecting race staff and race assets.
bonus.fatigueDesc: Reduces race fatigue pressure, travel fatigue, and fatigue floor effects.
bonus.recoveryDesc: Improves daily recovery, recovery duration, and post-stage recovery.
bonus.healthDesc: Reduces injury risk, illness risk, and minor health problems.
bonus.mechanicalDesc: Reduces mechanical problems, mechanical time loss, and equipment-related race issues.
bonus.raceSupportDesc: Improves feeding, team-car coverage, race logistics, and tactical support.

stagePlans.title: Stage Plans
stagePlans.notOpen: Stage Plans open after the Race Plan is submitted.

stagePlans.u23ViewOnly: This Stage Plan is managed automatically by the U23 Head Coach and is view-only.
stagePlans.notesPlaceholder: Add tactical notes for this stage...
stagePlans.lockInfo: Stage Plans lock 3 in-game hours before stage start.
stagePlans.rolesHelp: Assign one race role to each selected rider for this stage.
stagePlans.equipmentHelp: Choose the equipment setup used by each rider for this stage.
stagePlans.suppliesHelp: Configure race supplies for the stage. Consumables are deducted when the stage is processed.
stagePlans.individualHelp: Individual phase tactics can override the general team plan for one rider during a specific phase.

riderRoles.teamLeaderDesc: Main protected rider for the general classification and the rider teammates should protect during key race moments.
riderRoles.sprinterDesc: Primary rider for flat sprint finishes and suitable intermediate sprint opportunities.
riderRoles.climberDesc: Primary rider for difficult climbs, mountain finishes and suitable KOM opportunities.
riderRoles.helperDesc: General support rider who protects teammates, carries out team work and assists with positioning or pace control.
riderRoles.breakawayRiderDesc: Rider selected to attack or join a breakaway when an individual phase instruction allows it.
riderRoles.breakawayChaserDesc: Rider selected to help close dangerous breakaways and support peloton pursuit work.
riderRoles.freeRoleDesc: Neutral role without a fixed team duty. The rider follows phase instructions and reacts to the race situation.

tactics.balancedDesc: Default all-round plan. The team rides with normal energy use, reacts to the race, and does not overcommit too early.
tactics.aggressiveDesc: Higher-rhythm plan. Riders attack, chase and position more actively, but the team will usually spend more stamina.
tactics.sprintControlDesc: The team focuses on controlling the race for a sprint finish, protecting the sprinter, and organizing the sprint train.
tactics.breakawayDesc: The team gives more freedom to breakaway riders and spends less effort on pure sprint control unless the race situation changes.
tactics.gcProtectionDesc: Main focus is keeping the Team Leader safe, protected and well-positioned while avoiding unnecessary risks and fatigue.
tactics.climberSupportDesc: The team puts more support into climbs, mountain pacing and KOM/GC support on uphill sections.
tactics.ttBalancedDesc: Even effort across the whole stage. Safe default with low blow-up risk.
tactics.ttFastStartDesc: Hard first half, then hold the pace. Good for short prologues, risky for weaker TT riders.
tactics.ttNegativeSplitDesc: Controlled first half, stronger second half. Good for longer ITTs and riders with endurance.
tactics.ttAllOutDesc: Maximum pace from the start. Fastest option but high fatigue and blow-up risk.

weatherCancellation.stageCanceledBody: This stage was canceled by the race engine ({{reason}}). Stage Plans are locked because no result, points, prize money, fatigue or replay will be generated for this stage.
weatherCancellation.raceCanceledBody: This race was canceled due to weather. Race preparation is no longer needed for this race.
weatherCancellation.partlyCanceledBody: At least one stage in this race was canceled due to weather. Remaining uncanceled stages can continue normally.
weatherCancellation.likelyBody: Current forecast is below the safety threshold. Final decision 24 in-game hours before start.

legacyUi.roadRolesDisabled: Normal road roles are disabled on Prologue, ITT and TTT stages.
legacyUi.tttRidersExplainer: Every rider is treated as a Team Time Trial Rider. The engine calculates counting riders, dropped riders, team cohesion, support work and official team time.

screen.startingFreshnessHelp: Starting freshness combines fatigue and race sharpness. High fatigue can lower the red bar even when sharpness is good.
screen.missingStagePlansHelp: Some stage plans are still missing. Open Stage Plans and save each stage before race start.
screen.openLockHint: This stage plan is still open and can be edited until the lock time is reached.
screen.lockedLockHint: This Stage Plan is locked and can no longer be edited.
screen.openStageSaveHelp: Open this stage and save a real Stage Plan.
screen.chooseEquipmentPackage: Choose one equipment package for each rider for this stage.
screen.chooseRole: Choose one clear role for each rider. Detailed race orders are set below in Individual Tactics.
screen.phaseDescription: Phases 1–3 contain general race orders. Phase 4 contains finish preparation, sprint-train and lead-out orders.
screen.saveStageWarning: Do not forget to save this stage. These phase commands are saved only for the selected stage.
screen.stageSupplyDesc: Team-level supply setup for this stage. Consumables are applied per rider; Race Jersey Kit is mandatory and Rain Jackets are a team-wide yes/no choice.
screen.mandatoryJersey: Mandatory for all selected riders. Missing jersey kits block the stage setup.
screen.rainAutoUsed: Automatically used for all riders when the stage is rainy or below 15°C.
screen.weatherNoRisk: Weather: no strong weather risk detected. Missing jackets do not block the start, but increase illness exposure.
screen.stockCheckHelp: Needed for this stage compared with currently available club stock.
screen.stageSaveOnly: Stage Plan save only stores the plan. Consumables and durable item usage are applied later by the Race Engine when the stage is processed.
screen.finalCalcDesc: Team-level Race Engine preview for this exact stage setup: Race Plan bonuses, equipment, supplies, weather and risk factors.
screen.ttFinalCalcDesc: Time-trial Race Engine preview for equipment, support, fatigue, weather and pacing risk.
screen.durabilityNote: Jerseys: 10 stage uses each. Rain jackets: 25 stage uses each. Jackets reduce bad-weather sickness risk by 50%, but add -1% rider efficiency whenever used.
screen.bonusDescription: Race staff, race assets, and team policies are converted into these standardized Race Engine percentage bonuses. Hover or click a card to see the source breakdown.
screen.fatigueDesc: Reduces race fatigue pressure, travel fatigue, and fatigue floor effects.
screen.recoveryDesc: Improves daily recovery, recovery duration, and post-stage recovery.
screen.healthDesc: Reduces injury risk, illness risk, and minor health problems.
screen.mechanicalDesc: Reduces mechanical problems, mechanical time loss, and equipment-related race issues.
screen.raceSupportDesc: Improves feeding, team-car coverage, race logistics, and tactical support.
